svg.text: Relational Schema – Contract Risk & Clause Intelligence
Legend – Foreign Key Constraints (arrow: FK attribute → referenced PK)
underlined = Primary Key | coloured bold text = Foreign Key (colour matches its arrow) | CONTRACT_PARTIES has composite PK (contract_id, party_id)
UNIQUE: roles.role_name, users.email, risk_categories.category_name | Indexes: clauses(contract_id), risk_flags(clause_id), deadlines(deadline_date)
